content: A cottage industry of Brazilian BI/integration vendors (Kondado, Integrai, Irroba, etc.) already builds Power BI / Looker Studio / Google Sheets dashboards on top of Tiny ERP data covering Resumo, Marketplace, Vendas, Clientes, Estoque and Curva ABC pages, and track conversion rate, average ticket, best-selling products, average payment time, accounts receivable status. This confirms real unmet demand for a BI layer beyond Tiny's native reports, and validates that 'products/inventory' + 'vendas' + 'clientes' are the standard pillars such dashboards cover.
